text:
incident-bot: PAGER: Spike in 429/5xx across hosted API in us-west-2, error rate ~18% over baseline for the last 3m. Customers affected: small-medium (PLG), some enterprise tails. Auto-escalation to oncall.

alex.k: seeing it too — internal dashboard shows sudden increase in request fanout from a single client app in us-west-2. 429s mostly on /v1/generate and streaming endpoints.

maria.s: tagging in prod-sre - are autoscalers behaving? any queue backlog?

prod-sre: Autoscaling healthy, but per-host tokenization cache thrash observed. CPU on a few infer nodes at ~95%. KV cache miss rate jumped. Might be a hot key or long prompt distribution.

samir: can we throttle the noisy tenant quickly? We have tenant_id=acct_7f2b... showing 10x requests. If we rate-limit them at the edge we can drop overall pressure.

alex.k: agree. Proposed live mitigations (short list): 1) Apply tenant-level rate limit to acct_7f2b.* at ingress (50r/s) 2) Temporarily disable streaming for that tenant 3) Increase short-term quota window for infra (to avoid healthy clients hitting quota) 4) Add 429 Retry-After header guidance in responses. Thoughts?

jen-l: +1 to tenant-level throttle and disable streaming. Streaming appears to multiply concurrency by keeping connections open. Also suggest enabling per-route prioritization to favor low-latency customers.

maria.s: can we do an emergency quota override for enterprise customers impacted by collateral throttling? We need to avoid SLAs breaking.

prod-sre: I can push a per-tenant rate limit rule now. Will mark as temporary and log change. Pushing rule in 2m.

incident-bot: action created: #A-5682 apply-rate-limit acct_7f2b, owner=prod-sre, due=1769876600

alex.k: client/SDK guidance that we should send to customers (and to include in status updates): short bullet list —
- Use exponential backoff with full jitter on 429/5xx responses. Example: base=200ms, max=10s, factor=2.
- Respect Retry-After header if present.
- For idempotent requests, include idempotency token header `X-Idempotency-Key` to allow safe retries.
- Reduce parallelism: cap concurrent requests per connection to 4 when retrying.
- If streaming is disabled, fallback to non-streaming endpoints gracefully.

samir: add recommendation about token and prompt caching on client side: reuse prefixes where possible to reduce tokenization churn. Also suggest clients implement request coalescing for the same prompt within 100ms window.

maria.s: drafting the message for status.redwood.ai — we should call out mitigations and ETA: temp rate-limit + streaming off for offender, monitoring for 15m, then can adjust. Also guidance for SDKs included.

jen-l: handoff note for next oncall (2am shift): if error rate doesn't drop below 3% in 15m, escalate to infra-night lead and consider rolling back any recent route config that added new models.

prod-sre: rate-limit rule applied at 1769876578. Immediate decrease in traffic from acct_7f2b observed. Error rate fell to ~6% within 2m.

incident-bot: Note: config-change audit logged in ops-audit id=op_983221.

alex.k: good progress. Next actions: 1) Keep monitoring KV cache miss pattern 2) If miss rate stays high, consider warming caches for top n prompts or pinning model shards 3) Prepare a customer communication snippet for affected PLG customers — explain transient throttling and provide SDK best practices.

samir: working on a quick SDK patch we can publish to docs: add example retry snippet:
```
// JS pseudo
async function callWithRetry(req) {
  let attempt = 0;
  const max = 6;
  while (attempt < max) {
    const res = await client.generate(req);
    if (![429,500,502,503,504].includes(res.status)) return res;
    const ra = parseInt(res.headers['retry-after'] || '0');
    const backoff = ra > 0 ? ra*1000 : Math.min(10000, 200 * Math.pow(2, attempt));
    await sleep(jitter(backoff));
    attempt++;
  }
  throw new Error('Retries exhausted');
}
```
Include note: add `X-Idempotency-Key` for any retried stateful calls.

maria.s: updating the incident thread and adding the snippet to the status page. Also tagging CS for any customers who DM about errors.

jen-l: handoff: alex.k remains primary until 1769877000. If further action needed, page infra lead sam.h. Leaving the channel notes: throttle applied, streaming disabled for offender, monitoring threshold 3%, next review in 15m.

alex.k: quick reminder to ops: when removing throttle, do it gradually (multistep: 50 -> 200 -> 500 r/s) and watch KV cache miss rate.

prod-sre: monitoring: as of 1769876810 error rate ~2.1%, KV miss trending down. Will keep rule in place for 20m then start gradual relaxation.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations in place, partial customer impact, mitigation successful so far. Will close or escalate based on next check.

alex.k: thanks everyone. I'll write the post-incident notes and recommend a follow-up: add per-tenant request sampling to detect noisy clients earlier and a quick-runbook for clients to implement idempotency and exponential backoff.

maria.s: closing this thread for now, but keep logs and audit entries linked for postmortem. Please add any follow-up tasks to the incident board. :white_check_mark:
